newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air NZ boosts Aussie flights amid rubgy fever.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ boosts Aussie flights amid rubgy fever.

text.p: Air New Zealand said on Friday it had piled on extra flights to Melbourne to take All Blacks fans to and from Saturday evening's Bledisloe Cup rugby union international.

"It's got to be a record," Air New Zealand sales and marketing manager Brent Larsen said of the 14 extra flights added to a scheduled 10 due to depart from the country's international gateways as the weekend approaches.
The company expects about 4,000 extra passengers will be carried and, responding to the preponderance of rugby fans among them, the airline is theming its flights around the game.
Inflight service crews are wearing specially-designed Bledisloe Cup jerseys and entertainment will be provided with a rugby theme including a full replay of last year's Bledisloe Cup clash.
